defect: The fix makes PrepopulateBlockCache::kFlushOnly warm the cache only for flushes by keeping the creation reason in Rep; the kFlushOnly logic in WriteRawBlock was added by a later commit.
reason: This change only added reason/level fields to FilterBuildingContext and moved the null filter_policy check; the defective prepopulate logic did not exist in it.

defect: rocksdb_compression_list_helper declares a variable-length array jbyte jbuf[compressionLevels.size()], a non-standard extension that does not compile with MSVC on Windows.
reason: The VLA was introduced by this change and the fix replaces exactly it with a heap array.

defect: The default constructor initializes log_prefix but leaves the new member log_prefix_len uninitialized, while Logv uses it to size and fill the buffer.
reason: The fix adds log_prefix_len(0) to exactly the constructor this change modified.

defect: GetOneHotKeyID assigns std::floor results (double) to int64_t, an implicit narrowing conversion that MSVC warns about, breaking the /WX (FAIL_ON_WARNINGS) build of db_stress.
reason: The lines were added by this change and the fix replaces them with integer arithmetic to repair the MSVC build.

defect: TestCompactRange declares uint32_t pre_hash without an initializer and reads it under a different condition, triggering MSVC's potentially-uninitialized-variable warning that fails the /WX build.
reason: The function was added by this change and the fix only initializes pre_hash.

defect: The fix removes the DB mutex unlock/relock in ColumnFamilyData::UnrefAndTryDelete, which drops the mutex parameter of InstallSuperVersion; this change only removed the fromMemPurge argument.
reason: The race goes back years before this change according to the fix message, and this change's edit is unrelated to it.

defect: Fast_CRC32 is now gated on HAVE_SSE42 while IsFastCrc32Supported still keys on __SSE4_2__/_WIN64, so it can report fast CRC while the slow path is used.
reason: The fix message blames this commit and aligns isSSE42/IsFastCrc32Supported with HAVE_SSE42 in lines this change edited.

defect: StartBenchmark iterates config by value and passes the address of the loop-local copy to StartThread, so threads use a dangling WorkerThread and the wait loop polls copies whose stopped flag never changes.
reason: The new file introduced this and the fix switches to heap-allocated WorkerThread pointers.

defect: The fix makes the file-system-provided buffer a BlockFetcher member so it outlives ReadBlockContents for the later compressed-block access in the tiered secondary cache path.
reason: Before this change the FS buffer was freed even earlier (end of ReadBlock, and earlier still at the end of ReadBlockContents), so the stale access after ReadBlockContents predates it.

defect: InternalKeyComparator::Name returns c_str() of a temporary std::string, a dangling pointer.
reason: Introduced by this change and fixed the same day by returning a member string.

defect: ParseFileName no longer recognizes the legacy LOG.old file name as an info log file.
reason: The change removed the LOG.old case and the fix restores it in ParseFileName.

defect: The fix passes output_level instead of start_level to GetCompressionType/GetCompressionOptions in PickCompactionToReduceSortedRuns.
reason: start_level was already passed before this change, which only removed the ioptions_ argument and reformatted the call.

defect: ShardedLRUCache::SetCapacity overrides a virtual Cache method without the override keyword, breaking the Clang build (inconsistent-missing-override with warnings as errors).
reason: The method was added by this change and the fix only adds override.

defect: The fix rewrites CalcHashBitsTest to sweep many more inputs after CalcHashBits was fixed in fast_lru_cache.cc.
reason: The fix on this file is a test change; the off-by-one defect lies in another file.

defect: AbortIO passes a Posix_IOHandle* as the second argument of io_uring_prep_cancel, which newer liburing declares as __u64, so the build fails.
reason: The call was added by this change and the fix changes exactly that argument; seeing the failure needs the liburing header.

defect: The fix replaces addfile_cv_ with bg_cv_ and moves the wait for running AddFile calls into ShouldntRunManualCompaction to close the AddFile/CompactRange conflict.
reason: The AddFile versus manual compaction conflict predates this change, which only partly addressed it; the addfile_cv_ signalling itself was not defective.

defect: The new trivial-move loop over input levels deletes each file from c->level() instead of c->level(l), leaving files from non-start levels duplicated.
reason: The loop was introduced by this change and the fix corrects the DeleteFile level.

defect: The fix passes column_families to impl->Recover in OpenWithColumnFamilies after a bad merge on the column-family branch.
reason: At this change Recover() took no column-family argument, so the call was correct; the error came from a later merge.

defect: InstallMemtableFlushResults scans completed memtables once and never rechecks after LogAndApply releases the mutex, so flushes that finish meanwhile (whose threads return due to commit_in_progress_) stay uncommitted.
reason: The old outer while loop rescanned the list; this change removed it and the fix restores a retry loop.

defect: WaitAll skips handles whose IsReady() is true, but ResultHandle::IsReady also returns true when the inner nvm handle is already ready, so those handles never get size/value set, causing false negatives.
reason: WaitAll and ResultHandle were both introduced by this change; seeing it requires the IsReady definition in the header.

defect: The fix adds a ready_before_wait option to the test secondary cache and a test for the WaitAll false negative.
reason: Test change only; the defect lies in tiered_secondary_cache.cc.

defect: ReturnSeuqneceNumberMultiThreaded shares one non-thread-safe Random across 16 writer threads, a data race.
reason: The test was added by this change and the fix gives each thread its own Random.

defect: The fix stops asserting that RandomRWFile::Allocate succeeds because tmpfs may not support fallocate.
reason: The fix only relaxes a test expectation for some filesystems; no product defect is repaired.

defect: The public header include/rocksdb/utilities/convenience.h now includes the internal utilities/pragma_error.h, which is not available to users building against installed headers (e.g. MongoDB).
reason: The include was added by this change and the fix removes it to repair the downstream build.

defect: The fix renames the NPERF_CONTEXT/iOS stub macro to PERF_CONDITIONAL_TIMER_FOR_MUTEX_GUARD to match a later rename.
reason: At this change both branches defined PERF_CONDITIONAL_TIMER_GUARD consistently; commit fb9811ee9 later renamed only one branch.

defect: The fix makes ldb flag parsing exact-match instead of prefix-match across all commands.
reason: Prefix matching was the existing convention in every command before this change; the fix is a parsing-strictness improvement rather than the repair of a defect introduced here.

defect: lookupSnapshot and lookupIterator print an int64_t with %d, a printf format mismatch (undefined behaviour).
reason: Those lines were added by this change and the fix changes them to %ld.

defect: parseOptions scans --cache_size with %ld into the int n, writing a long into an int (stack corruption, undefined behaviour).
reason: The new file introduced it and the fix scans into a 64-bit variable.

defect: The fix adds an eviction counter and a NoOldestFileToEvict test for the min_element crash fixed in blob_db_impl.cc.
reason: Test change only; the crash was in blob_db_impl.cc.

defect: TransactionDBOptions::write_policy has no default initializer, so default-constructed options carry an uninitialized write policy.
reason: The field was added by this change and the fix initializes it to WRITE_COMMITTED.

defect: BlobDB overrides the std::string Get overload, but DB's designated virtual getter is the PinnableSlice overload, so Get through that path returns the stored blob index instead of the value.
reason: The BlobDB class was introduced by this change; seeing it needs DB::Get's overloads in db.h.

defect: AllocateNewBlock uses std::make_unique<char[]>, which zero-initializes every arena block, touching all pages and raising memory use.
reason: The line was introduced by this change and the fix goes back to new char[].

defect: Local handler structs in the new tests odr-use the enclosing function's non-static const locals kKeyValueSize/kNumUpdates, which Clang rejects, breaking the Clang build.
reason: The tests were added by this change and the fix makes the constants static.

defect: The new memtable_factory/memtable parse lambdas reset the shared factory whenever CreateFromString returns OK, even when it returns OK with a null factory under ignore_unsupported_options, overwriting the option with null.
reason: The lambdas were written by this change and the fix adds the null check; seeing it needs CreateFromString's semantics.

defect: The fix skips SleepForMicroseconds when the debug state delay is 0, avoiding a usleep(0) on every mutex lock in debug builds.
reason: This change restored a file whose TEST_StateDelay code was identical to the version deleted by e60bc99, so the behaviour predates it (and it is a debug-only slowdown).

defect: In collapsed mode AddToBuilder only skips the final sentinel and writes the seq-0 gap sentinels in the middle of the map into output files as real tombstones.
reason: The collapsed-mode loop was added by this change and the fix skips seq_ == 0 sentinels.

defect: NewTableBuilder writes the mock ID through file->writable_file(), bypassing WritableFileWriter, so the writer's size stays 0 and Close truncates the file, losing the ID.
reason: That call was introduced by this change and the fix writes through the writer; the effect needs WritableFileWriter's size tracking and truncation.

defect: The fix de-flakes PersistRoundRobinCompactCursor by flushing each batch and adjusting level and file sizes.
reason: Test change only; no code defect is repaired.

defect: CreateAndDropRace passes the comparators vector by value to the thread and never deletes the remaining comparators, leaking them (valgrind error).
reason: The test was added by this change and the fix passes a pointer and frees all comparators.

defect: RecoverLogFiles pushes all recovered WALs into alive_log_files_ whenever nothing was flushed, including when the WALs held no data, which makes DB::Open fail.
reason: The block was added by this change and the fix restricts it to when data was seen; the failure involves the DB::Open path outside the diff.
